nemo-rl/tierb.purpose: NeMo RL trainer image built from NeMo RL's own docker/Dockerfile at the pinned commit (the Tier B image, local tag nemo-rl:4f39fd8)

nemo-rl/tierb-uid1000.purpose: the Tier B image plus one layer handing the ten vLLM files NeMo RL patches at start-up to uid 1000 (a trainer running as 1000:1000)

accepted.note: reference build from the pre-ARG file, same chown list; see containers/nemo-rl-uid1000 (the shipped Containerfile later took BASE as a build argument; no hash is recorded because the shipped file is not the file that built this image)

nemo-rl/tierb-rootless.purpose: the Tier B image plus one layer making those vLLM files owned by root, for a rootless Docker host (build it with containers/nemo-rl-rootless; the ID is host specific, add it with `gatedtrain image add`)
